title: NXT: the fight against DarkState
summary: DarkState’s numbers swing a tag match. Montana fights back, and returning NXT alumni Fraxiom meet the faction in the Dusty Classic.

chapters.title: Saquon Shugars & Dion Lennox & Osiris Griffin vs. Tony D'Angelo & Channing "Stacks" Lorenzo & Luca Crusifino
chapters.result: Saquon Shugars & Dion Lennox & Osiris Griffin defeated Tony D'Angelo & Channing "Stacks" Lorenzo & Luca Crusifino via Pinfall.

chapters.result: Joe Hendry is attacked by DarkState.

chapters.title: Dion Lennox & Osiris Griffin vs. Hank Walker & Tank Ledger
chapters.result: Dion Lennox & Osiris Griffin defeated Hank Walker & Tank Ledger via Pinfall to win the Titles.

chapters.title: The Hardy Boyz (Matt & Jeff Hardy)
chapters.result: The Hardy Boyz (Matt & Jeff Hardy) (c) [TNA] defeat DarkState (Dion Lennox & Osiris Griffin) (c) [NXT] to win the NXT titles

chapters.title: Dion Lennox & Osiris Griffin vs. "Broken" Matt Hardy & Brother Nero
chapters.result: Dion Lennox & Osiris Griffin defeated "Broken" Matt Hardy & Brother Nero via Pinfall to win the Titles.
